sanitizerRetains.structuralStatus: turn/end reason.kind, assistant/attempt status, tool/result recorded|unknown

doesNotReadToolResultAsSuccess.meaning: a tool/result event exists; this is NOT proof the tool succeeded
doesNotReadToolResultAsSuccess.sourceEvidence: DSH exposes `tool/result.message.isError` and `tool/result.error.code` as official STRUCTURAL fields outside model content, but the product's sanitizer does not read them

capsuleCanEstablish: which Invocations existed (from the association, not the sanitizer)
which events were actually observed (type + seq)
which historical areas remain unknown (uncertainty block)

targetB_engineeringFailureAvoidance.reason: the sanitizer excludes what a tool RETURNED, why a command FAILED and what an assistant CONCLUDED, so a sequence of tool/call + tool/result structural events cannot communicate a failure CAUSE
targetB_engineeringFailureAvoidance.implication: a benchmark claiming 'the agent avoids repeating a failed command' would NOT be measuring Capsule content with the current sanitizer

eventWindowSufficiency.selectionPolicy: PREFIX from the start of the read page
eventWindowSufficiency.assumptionNotMade: nothing establishes that the task-relevant failure evidence lies within that prefix
eventWindowSufficiency.requiredBeforeTrial: freeze the selection policy (prefix / bounded suffix / explicit historical segment); the model must receive no unrestricted Session-range authority

sensitiveContentNotBroadened.why: §11.3 forbids replacing the sanitizer with raw JSON and forbids enlarging it merely to manufacture an experimental effect; no narrow new field was added because the current stage does not establish that a specific engineering-failure judgment is both necessary and safely available

expectedInvariant: the information-sufficiency audit honestly states which judgments the current Capsule CAN and CANNOT support, and sensitive raw content is not disclosed merely to improve an experimental effect
remainingUncertainty: Target B (Engineering Failure Avoidance) is NOT supported by the current Capsule content; a future stage would need a source-grounded, narrowly-scoped structural field to support it, which D2 does not add
